title: Ada and the Autopsy
author: E. M. Halloran
blurb: Elodie Sandoval, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
